o: The heat is on as the Hot Wheels kids race to save the Ultimate Garage from a flashy new challenger who's driving a car loaded with special powers!

eps.t: Cruise Control / The S'more Fun the Better
eps.o: In the first race of Level 2, a mysterious newcomer hits the track and shakes up the competition. Then it's time to make s'mores — Hot Wheels style!
An accident shrinks Coop, Mac and Spark in their cars. Professor Rearview drops a giant, hungry shark on the city's new Ultra Car Wash.

eps.t: Cruisin' to Victory / The Great Car Swap
eps.o: Can Coop climb the leaderboard, or will Cruise drive away with a victory? Later on, the campers switch cars to learn valuable new racing skills.

eps.t: Go for the Gold / Sneezy Squeakers
eps.o: The racers search Hot Wheels City for the lucky Golden Steering Wheel. Brights uses creativity to help Squeakers feel better.
Professor Rearview and his monster bat steal Dash's favorite car. Then the pressure's on to win the third race — but can Coop stay calm and focused?
